exampleSentence.hanzi: 真挚的爱情需要彼此坦诚相待与共同成长。
exampleSentence.pinyin: Zhēnzhì de àiqíng xūyào bǐcǐ tǎnchéng xiāngdài yǔ gòngtóng chéngzhǎng.
exampleSentence.translation: Sincere romantic love demands reciprocal honesty and joint growth.

exampleSentence.hanzi: 秘书合理安排了总经理一整天紧凑的行程。
exampleSentence.pinyin: Mìshū hélǐ ānpái le zǒngjīnglǐ yì zhěngtiān jǐncòu de xíngchéng.
exampleSentence.translation: The secretary reasonably arranged the general manager's packed full-day schedule.

exampleSentence.hanzi: 无论是在生产车间还是户外探险，安全始终位居首位。
exampleSentence.pinyin: Wúlùn shì zài shēngchǎn chējiān háishi hùwài tànxiǎn, ānquán shǐzhōng wèijū shǒuwèi.
exampleSentence.translation: Whether in manufacturing workshops or outdoor expeditions, safety always ranks foremost.

exampleSentence.hanzi: 工程团队克服诸多困难，按时交付了高质量项目成果。
exampleSentence.pinyin: Gōngchéng tuánduì kèfú zhūduō kùnnan, ànshí jiāofù le gāo zhìliàng xiàngmù chéngguǒ.
exampleSentence.translation: The engineering team overcame manifold hurdles, delivering high-quality deliverables on time.

exampleSentence.hanzi: 我们要严格按照既定规章制度与操作规程行事。
exampleSentence.pinyin: Wǒmen yào yángé ànzhào jìdìng guīzhāng zhìdù yǔ cāozuò guīchéng xíngshì.
exampleSentence.translation: We must act in strict accordance with established regulations and operating procedures.

exampleSentence.hanzi: 本次顾客满意度调查结果高达百分之九十八。
exampleSentence.pinyin: Běn cì gùkè mǎnyìdù diàochá jiéguǒ gāodá bǎifēnzhī jiǔshíbā.
exampleSentence.translation: The outcome of this customer satisfaction survey reached ninety-eight percent.

exampleSentence.hanzi: 大家齐心协力呈现了一场非常棒的创新话剧。
exampleSentence.pinyin: Dàjiā qíxīn xiélì chéngxiàn le yì chǎng fēicháng bàng de chuàngxīn huàjù.
exampleSentence.translation: Everyone united efforts to present an extraordinarily fantastic innovative stage play.

exampleSentence.hanzi: 热气腾腾的灌汤包子散发着诱人的鲜美肉香。
exampleSentence.pinyin: Rèqì-téngténg de guàntāng bāozi sànfā zhe yòurén de xiānměi ròuxiāng.
exampleSentence.translation: Steaming soup-filled buns exuded an alluring savory aroma.

exampleSentence.hanzi: 保护地球生态环境是全人类休戚与共的使命。
exampleSentence.pinyin: Bǎohù dìqiú shēngtài huánjìng shì quán rénlèi xiūqī-yǔgòng de shǐmìng.
exampleSentence.translation: Protecting Earth's ecology is the shared mission of all humankind.

exampleSentence.hanzi: 企业必须保证产品品质以赢得消费者的长久信赖。
exampleSentence.pinyin: Qǐyè bìxū bǎozhèng chǎnpǐn pǐnzhì yǐ yíngdé xiāofèizhě de chángjiǔ xìnlài.
exampleSentence.translation: Enterprises must guarantee product quality to win enduring consumer trust.

exampleSentence.hanzi: 母亲深情地抱起熟睡中的婴儿轻声哼唱催眠曲。
exampleSentence.pinyin: Mǔqīn shēnqíng de bào qǐ shúshuì zhōng de yīng'ér qīngshēng hēngchàng cuīmiánqǔ.
exampleSentence.translation: The mother tenderly hugged the slumbering infant and softly hummed a lullaby.

exampleSentence.hanzi: 非常抱歉给您的工作带来了不必要的困扰。
exampleSentence.pinyin: Fēicháng bàoqiàn gěi nín de gōngzuò dàilái le bú bìyào de kùnrǎo.
exampleSentence.translation: Extremely sorry for bringing unnecessary disruption to your work.

exampleSentence.hanzi: 众多青年才俊踊跃报名参加全球创新科技大赛。
exampleSentence.pinyin: Zhòngduō qīngnián cáijùn yǒngyuè bàomíng cānjiā quánqiú chuàngxīn kējì dàsài.
exampleSentence.translation: Multitudes of young talents enthusiastically signed up for the global innovation tech contest.

exampleSentence.hanzi: 这项规划本来打算下季度推行，现已提前启动。
exampleSentence.pinyin: Zhè xiàng guīhuà běnlái dǎsuàn xià jìdù tuīxíng, xiàn yǐ tíqián qǐdòng.
exampleSentence.translation: This initiative was originally slated for rollout next quarter, but has now commenced ahead of time.

exampleSentence.hanzi: 勤能补拙，即使自认笨拙也能靠坚持取得成功。
exampleSentence.pinyin: Qín néng bǔ zhuō, jíshǐ zì rèn bènzhuō yě néng kào jiānchí qǔdé chénggōng.
exampleSentence.translation: Diligence remedies clumsiness; even if one feels clumsy, persistence yields triumph.

exampleSentence.hanzi: 轻便且性能出众的笔记本电脑是现代办公利器。
exampleSentence.pinyin: Qīngbiàn qiě xìngnéng chūzhòng de bǐjìběn diànnǎo shì xiàndài bàngōng lìqì.
exampleSentence.translation: Lightweight laptop computers with exceptional performance are modern productivity powerhouses.

exampleSentence.hanzi: 大学毕业典礼上，毕业生们满怀憧憬迈向新征程。
exampleSentence.pinyin: Dàxué bìyè diǎnlǐ shàng, bìyèshēng men mǎnhuái chōngjǐng màixiàng xīn zhēngchéng.
exampleSentence.translation: At the university commencement ceremony, graduates stepped forward into new journeys with great aspiration.

exampleSentence.hanzi: 这部传世经典文学著作值得我们反复细读三遍。
exampleSentence.pinyin: Zhè bù chuánshì jīngdiǎn wénxué zhùzuò zhíde wǒmen fǎnfù xìdú sān biàn.
exampleSentence.translation: This timeless literary classic is worthy of our repeated thorough perusal three times.

exampleSentence.hanzi: 团队树立了极为严格的产品质量检验标准。
exampleSentence.pinyin: Tuánduì shùlì le jíqí yángé de chǎnpǐn zhìliàng jiǎnyàn biāozhǔn.
exampleSentence.translation: The team established extremely rigorous product quality inspection standards.

exampleSentence.hanzi: 请在提交申请前仔细核对电子表格里的每项数据。
exampleSentence.pinyin: Qǐng zài tíjiāo shēnqǐng qián zǐxì h किसानोंé diànzǐ biǎogé lǐ de měi xiàng shùjù.
exampleSentence.translation: Please carefully verify each data point in the spreadsheet before submitting the application.

exampleSentence.hanzi: 诗人用极其凝练优美的词句表达了对祖国的挚爱。
exampleSentence.pinyin: Shīrén yòng jíqí níngliàn yōuměi de cíjù biǎodá le duì zǔguó de zhì'ài.
exampleSentence.translation: The poet conveyed profound devotion to the motherland using succinct and poetic verse.

exampleSentence.hanzi: 请务必真实准确地填写个人信息统计表格。
exampleSentence.pinyin: Qǐng wùbì zhēnshí zhǔnquè de tiánxiě gèrén xìnxī tǒngjì biǎogé.
exampleSentence.translation: Please be sure to genuinely and accurately fill out the personal information table.

exampleSentence.hanzi: 这道方案不仅切实可行，并且能大幅削减运营成本。
exampleSentence.pinyin: Zhè dào fāng'àn bùjǐn qièshí kěxíng, bìngqiě néng dàfú xuējiǎn yùnyíng chéngběn.
exampleSentence.translation: This scheme is not only feasible, but furthermore can drastically curb operational costs.

exampleSentence.hanzi: 他经过多年潜心钻研，终于获得了人工智能博士学位。
exampleSentence.pinyin: Tā jīngguò duō nián qiánxīn zuānyán, zhōngyú huòdé le réngōng zhìnéng bóshì xuéwèi.
exampleSentence.translation: After years of dedicated scholarly research, he finally earned a PhD in Artificial Intelligence.

exampleSentence.hanzi: 这项前沿科技不但极具创新性，而且具备广阔的应用前景。
exampleSentence.pinyin: Zhè xiàng qiányán kējì búdàn jí jù chuàngxīnxìng, érqiě jùbèi guǎngkuò de yìngyòng qiánjǐng.
exampleSentence.translation: This frontier technology not only possesses tremendous innovation, but also embraces broad application prospects.
